subject.title: [Bug]: failed image attachment loads are silently dropped from the model prompt — model answers as if no image was sent

question: Where should OpenClaw surface failed native image attachment loads: model-visible prompt markers, user/operator diagnostics, turn failure, or a combination?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the durable contract changes model-visible text, user-facing behavior, logging, path disclosure, and multiple caller surfaces.

options.title: Prompt Marker Contract
options.body: Return skipped-image metadata and have embedded, CLI, and harness callers add a safe model-visible marker or count without full local paths, so the model cannot answer as if no image was sent.

options.title: Diagnostics Only
options.body: Emit user/operator diagnostics while leaving the model prompt unchanged, which avoids prompt wording policy but still lets the model answer without the missing image.

options.title: Fail Current Turn
options.body: Treat failed current-turn image attachment loads as input errors, giving the strongest user signal but potentially breaking workflows where optional prompt refs fail.

recommendation.title: Prompt Marker Contract
recommendation.body: Return skipped-image metadata and have embedded, CLI, and harness callers add a safe model-visible marker or count without full local paths, so the model cannot answer as if no image was sent.
